about: STEP 3, FIND IS THE ONLY WAY AROUND (owner, 14 Nov): every screen, column and special flow that is not yet reached as a Find branch, with what it shows, who sees it, how it is reached and what data it needs. Read as docs/find-only.md. js/check-find-only.js keeps this list honest; check/find-only-ratchet.json counts the columns still standing and only goes down.

statuses.find: Find itself: the one front door.
statuses.moved: A Find branch only: its column, its screen code and its <section> are gone; the old name opens the branch (screens-moved.json).
statuses.redirect: A Find branch exists and the old name opens it, but the column's code still stands (switched off). Next to delete.
statuses.column: A column of its own, switched on: still reached by swiping, not by Find.
statuses.off: A column switched off: Find shows one Coming soon card for it; its code still stands.
statuses.flow: Not a column: a sheet (pop-over) or a link that opens something outside Find.
